summary: Apply a given linear binary operation on reals twice in succession to get a number.
template: For a*b = {p}a + {q}b on R, evaluate ({x}*{y})*{z}.

summary: Principal value of an inverse tangent minus an inverse secant of standard values.
template: Find the principal value of tan^-1({u}) - sec^-1({v}).

topic: Order, types and equality of matrices
summary: Use equality of matrices after scalar multiplication and addition to find x + y.
template: From {k}[[x,{a}],[{b},y-{c}]] + {B} = {C}, find x + y.

summary: Given a transpose of one matrix and another matrix, compute the difference of their transposes.
template: Given A^T = {P} and B = {Q}, find A^T - B^T.

summary: Find the determinant of a scalar multiple of a 3x3 matrix with known determinant.
template: A is {n}x{n} with |A| = {d}; find |{k}A|.

summary: Evaluate a definite integral of a square root of a constant minus x squared over a quarter-circle range.
template: Evaluate the integral from 0 to {a} of sqrt({a}^2 - x^2) dx.

summary: Identify f(x) in an integral of the form e^x times (f plus its derivative).
template: Given integral of e^x({g}(x)) dx = e^x f(x) + c, find f(x).

summary: Evaluate a combination of a cross product and dot products of unit coordinate vectors.
template: Find the value of ({u} x {v}).{w} + {p}.{q} for unit vectors i, j, k.

topic: Vector basics, direction cosines and unit vectors
summary: Find scalar components of a vector between two given plane points.
template: Find the scalar components of AB where A = {A} and B = {B}.

summary: Distance of a given plane from the origin.
template: Find the distance of the plane {a}x + {b}y + {c}z = {d} from the origin.

summary: Prove that cosine of a sum of an inverse sine and inverse cotangent equals a given surd value.
template: Prove cos(sin^-1 {p} + cot^-1 {q}) = {r}.

summary: Use determinant properties to show a symmetric-looking 3x3 determinant in a, b, c equals 4abc.
template: Using properties, show that the determinant {D} equals {k}abc.

summary: Show a piecewise map on naturals (add or subtract one by parity) is bijective. OR: commutativity/associativity of two binary operations.
template: Show f: N -> N, f(x) = x+1 if x odd, x-1 if even, is one-one and onto.

summary: With x and y as roots of powers involving inverse sine and cosine of t, show dy/dx = -y/x. OR: differentiate an inverse tangent expression.
template: If x = sqrt(a^{sin^-1 t}), y = sqrt(a^{cos^-1 t}), show dy/dx = {result}.

summary: For parametric x and y involving cos t, sin t and t, find second derivatives with respect to t and x.
template: If x = {f}(t), y = {g}(t), find d2x/dt2, d2y/dt2 and d2y/dx2.

summary: Ladder sliding away from a wall: find how fast the top descends at a given foot distance.
template: A {L} m ladder's foot moves away at {v} cm/s; find the rate the top falls when foot is {d} m away.

summary: Integrate |x^3 - x| over an interval. OR: integral of x sin x over 1 + cos^2 x from 0 to pi.
template: Evaluate the integral from {a} to {b} of |x^3 - x| dx.

summary: Form the DE of circles in the second quadrant touching both axes. OR: particular solution of a separable DE via partial fractions.
template: Eliminate constants to get the DE for {family of circles tangent to both axes in a quadrant}.

summary: Solve a first-order linear DE whose right side involves cot x.
template: Solve ({p}(x)) dy + {q}(x) y dx = {r}(x) dx.

summary: Find a vector perpendicular to two given vectors with a given dot product with a third.
template: Find p perpendicular to {a} and {b} with p.{c} = {k}.

summary: Find where the line through two given space points meets the XY-plane.
template: Find where the line through {A} and {B} crosses the {plane}-plane.

summary: Mean and variance of the number of red cards when two cards are drawn without replacement.
template: Two cards drawn without replacement from 52; find mean and variance of number of {colour} cards.

topic: Solving linear equations by the matrix method
summary: Solve a 3x3 linear system using the matrix inverse.
template: Using matrices, solve {eq1}, {eq2}, {eq3}.

summary: Cylinder of greatest curved area inscribed in a cone has half its radius. OR: open square-based box from fixed cardboard area, maximum volume.
template: Prove that the cylinder of greatest curved surface inscribed in a cone of radius {R} has radius R/2.

summary: Integrate x times inverse sine over the root of 1 - x^2. OR: partial fractions with a repeated linear factor.
template: Evaluate integral of x sin^-1 x / sqrt(1 - x^2) dx.

summary: Area of the region inside a circle and above a chord line.
template: Find the area of {(x, y): x^2 + y^2 <= {r2}, x + y >= {c}}.

summary: Find k making two lines perpendicular, then the plane containing both lines.
template: Lines (x-1)/{a} = (y-2)/{b}k = (z-3)/{c} and ... are perpendicular; find k and the plane containing them.

summary: Die decides how many coin tosses; given exactly one head, find probability the die showed 1 to 4.
template: A die decides {n1} or {n2} coin tosses; given exactly one head, find P(die showed {event}).

summary: Diet problem: minimum-cost mix of two foods meeting two vitamin requirements; formulate and solve graphically.
template: Foods I, II give vitamins A, C at {rates}; need at least {a}, {c}; costs {p}, {q}/kg. Minimise cost graphically.
